name: app-pastel-tag-calendar-with-floating-event-cards
title: Calendar app with floating category tags and pastel event cards around the phone
whatItIs: A white board with a centred phone showing a month view with coloured dashes. Around it float removable category tags (Home, Plants, Friends, School, Work, Sport, Grandma) in bright pills, and event cards in warm grey with a category chip and a coloured letter tile. A headline reads 'Where your time finally makes sense'.
whatItMeans: Cheerful and organised; each colour is a life category, so the interface feels personal.
techniques: Explode UI components around the device to explain a colour-tagging system.
Give each category a solid colour used for dashes, chips and tiles.
Use a large letter tile as an avatar on event cards.
Place a light two-line headline beside the phone.

vocabulary.definition: Interface parts scattered around a device to explain them.
A coloured capsule naming a category.
A coloured block with a single letter as an icon.
